scientific_integrity: Complete analytic proof and standalone reproducible exact-arithmetic checks; no finite test is presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires exactly two identical complete layers joined by a full corresponding-vertex matching; all individual edge prices are fixed within their two classes.
The asymptotic limits hold with matching price c>0 fixed; no assertion is made for price sequences c=c(n).
The global minimizer is specified by a unique scalar root rather than an elementary closed-form expression.

An earlier July 2006 conference version of the general resistance-optimization framework exists, but its precise first-public-release day has not been verified; the August 29, 2006 source has a day-precise printed date.
The inspected literature does not rule out an unindexed equivalent result. Independent mathematical verification has not been performed.
title: Three allocation scales in priced complete prisms
